measurement_error_sigma.unit: relative SD of measured/true regional need (lognormal), per region, independent draws

data_lag_years.unit: years between true state and the data the allocator acts on (excludes build lead time)

leakage_no_safeguards.unit: share of allocated resources not reaching intended region/use

leakage_strong_safeguards.unit: share, with random audits + e-payments/e-procurement + published allocations + community monitoring

misreport_share_regions.unit: share of regions inflating reported need

misreport_inflation.unit: relative overstatement of need by a misreporting region (before central correction)

build_lead_years_supplementary.note: IEA 2023 via CNBC; add to data lag for energy capacity

basis: sigma: SA 2011 census omission 14.6% nationally with provincial range 10.0-18.6% (pre-adjustment); PPP revisions shift global poor counts by 6% (2017 PPP) up to ~400 m (2005 PPP); 57/155 countries had <=1 poverty data point in 2002-11, so high case reflects data-deprived regions. Lag: WB ~2-year collection-to-dissemination lag plus multi-year survey intervals. Leakage no safeguards: Uganda grants 80-87% captured (extreme, mid-1990s), India PDS 41.7-54%, Brazil audited municipalities 30% diverted, Olken ~24% (unverified), elite offshore capture of aid 7.5%. Strong safeguards: Uganda capture <20% after information campaign; PDS 8.8-28% by 2022-24; audits -8 pp (Olken); e-FMS -24%/-19% spending (Bihar/national); EU cohesion irregularity 6.4-9.3% (error, not theft) in a heavily audited system. Misreporting: Brazil FPM bunching 17-42% of near-threshold municipalities, 5.4% misclassified overall, size ~0.5-2.4% of population; China local data inflation ~5% of GDP corrected by NBS, Liaoning ~20% fiscal revenue, growth overstated 1.7 pp/yr 2008-16.
confidence: medium for leakage ranges (multiple RCT/PETS sources, but context-specific and mostly LMIC transfer programmes, not capacity construction); low-medium for sigma and misreport parameters (few direct measures of regional need error; values are modelling judgements anchored on census/PPP/manipulation evidence); medium for lag. Safeguard effects can add lag (Bihar payment delays). Ranges are not posterior distributions.
